Should ktbs.namespace itself have been migrated to ldpy? Partly yes, partly no -- unlike the SoftwareHeritage/swh-indexer sibling in this batch (a pure namespace-definitions module), lib/ktbs/namespace.py bundles the vocabulary Namespace object together with a rdfrest-backed REST description Service (`from rdfrest.cores.local import LocalCore, Service`, `make_helper_service(...)`) that serves the vocabulary graph over HTTP. The Namespace-definition half is exactly the `from … import p:` idiom's target shape; the Service half is not a namespace import at all and has no ldpy construction to migrate to. A hypothetical ldpy port would split the module rather than convert it wholesale -- the same shape of finding as the do_compute_obsels sibling's shim comment.

XSD (imported, `from rdflib import Literal, XSD`) is never referenced in the region body either -- `@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .` added for parity with the mechanical draft but genuinely unused; left in since removing an unused declaration the original also carries would be exactly the refactoring INSTRUCTIONS.md forbids.
